rows.text: The Presidency's profile says 'Mr Zuma was inaugurated as President of the Republic for his first term on the 9th May 2009'.

rows.text: The same profile says 'President Zuma assumed his second term in office as President of the Republic on 24 May 2014 following the ANC victory in the national general elections held on 7 May 2014'.
